name: GET /api/leadflow/sla/overnight-queue - signals that arrived outside business hours
description:
The overnight queue for SOP §04 out-of-hours handling: everything that arrived 17:00-08:59, at a weekend or on an approved holiday, with the commitment made to each customer.

EVERY ENTRY CARRIES ITS COMMITMENT (fe8a391f-f000-44aa-9f2a-ce108c98f951#AC1) - the next business open, the 08:45 owner task and the 09:30 first call - computed from the named business calendar rather than by adding hours. Verified live: a Saturday 19:00 Central arrival produced owner_task_due_at 2026-08-17T13:45Z and first_call_due_at 2026-08-17T14:30Z, which are 08:45 and 09:30 Monday CDT.

NO PROMISE IS RECORDED THAT NOBODY CAN KEEP (fe8a391f-f000-44aa-9f2a-ce108c98f951#AC4). same_night_promised carries a CHECK constraint that it can only be true when an on-call rep is named, so an optimistic promise cannot be stored even by a caller that bypasses the service. The response states that rule rather than leaving it to be inferred from a null.

GROUPED BY REASON because a holiday backlog is a staffing decision and a nightly one is routine, and a single count cannot tell an operator which they are looking at.

QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: The queue lists out-of-hours arrivals with their next-business-day commitment
Released entries can be included for a historical view
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
